snippet.title: Trailer Big Escape from CALYPSO Eng
snippet.description: A dark, atmospheric adventure in the surroundings of retro futuristic Sci-Fi from a solo developer. The main character finds himself on an abandoned colonization ship Calypso, drifting somewhere in space.
